prompts.initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone transparent pixel-art TECHNOLOGICAL FARMHOUSE building sprite for Floating Leaf Farm, a cozy mountain-valley farming game. Reference visible robot atlas is STYLE/PALETTE reference only, do not depict robot. One compact welcoming rural farmhouse with a broad pitched dark teal roof, cream walls, warm wooden door, two mint/cyan windows, subtle brass joints, a small neat rooftop solar panel array and a tiny brass antenna sensor. Technology should feel practical and gentle, not a spaceship or neon cyberpunk. Low one-storey cabin proportions, front wall dominant with a LITTLE right side and visible roof depth. Shallow elevated orthographic camera, vertical walls upright, front eaves and foundation horizontal, NOT 45-degree diamond isometric, not top-down. Upper-left light, three flat shade levels per material, dark #263f3c contour, #35665b teal roof/shadows, #8fc7a3 highlights, #f0e4bb cream walls, #c6b887 wall shade, #d7a44b brass and timber, #75bdd0 solar glass. Hard square chunky pixel steps, quiet warm desaturated palette matching the existing robot. Large clean pixel clusters, no smooth vector curves, gradients, glow, bloom, realism or blur. Full building centered with 10% clear alpha margin on all sides. Single rectangular foundation, no landscape island, grass, paths, mountain, ground plane, background, crop, character, vehicles, text, numbers, letters, signs or logos. Windows use solid flat tones, solar panels simple 2x3 rectangular dark cyan cells, small technological details readable at 200px display width. Entire outside is genuine alpha0 transparent; building opaque. No cast shadow outside footprint. Deliver one complete isolated farm building only.

No replacement backdrop, no black rectangle, no white rectangle, no checkerboard drawn into image. Genuine transparent cutout only. Exterior margin and all gaps around rooftop antenna transparent. No lighting effects outside silhouette.
